system.description:
Ingenious. One turret is a tool; a battery of them is a war machine. The Mechanist floods the field with sturdier sentries, choreographs their fire with their own, and unleashes every special ability at once when the moment demands it.

LEVEL 3

Master Technician. You can have up to two active turrets at once, and Turret Deployed! is no longer limited to 1/turn.

Extra Plating. Your turrets are only destroyed by a single instance of damage equal to 2xLVL.

LEVEL 7

Targeting Matrix. When a turret damages an enemy, the next attack against it has advantage.

LEVEL 11

Coordinated Assault. 1/turn, your firearm attacks make every Rifle Turret in range fire alongside you, sharing your hit/crit/miss.

LEVEL 15

Optimized Activation. 1/Safe Rest, spend 1 Toolbelt scrap to activate all active turrets' abilities without destroying them.
